-- Test: compute avg interaction gap per fan (in days)
SELECT interact_fan_pivot, 
       AVG(gap_days) AS avg_gap_days
FROM (
    SELECT interact_fan_pivot, time_mark,
           EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time_mark - LAG(time_mark) OVER (PARTITION BY interact_fan_pivot ORDER BY time_mark)))/86400.0 AS gap_days
    FROM interactions
) sub
WHERE gap_days IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot
ORDER BY avg_gap_days DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- Full query: At-Risk fans with their avg interaction gap, ordered by gap DESC
WITH at_risk_fans AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.user_registry, f.nick_label
    FROM retentionandinfluence r
    JOIN engagement e ON r.retain_engage_pivot = e.engage_reg
    JOIN membershipandspending ms ON e.engage_member_pivot = ms.member_reg
    JOIN fans f ON ms.member_fan_pivot = f.user_registry
    WHERE r.churn_flag = 'High'
),
fan_gaps AS (
    SELECT interact_fan_pivot, 
           AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time_mark - LAG(time_mark) OVER (PARTITION BY interact_fan_pivot ORDER BY time_mark)))/86400.0) AS avg_gap_days
    FROM interactions
    GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot
)
SELECT arf.nick_label, ROUND(CAST(fg.avg_gap_days AS numeric), 2) AS avg_interaction_gap
FROM at_risk_fans arf
JOIN fan_gaps fg ON arf.user_registry = fg.interact_fan_pivot
ORDER BY fg.avg_gap_days DESC;

-- Complete query: At-Risk fans (PSS/eng_rate < 0.4 OR churn_flag = 'High') with avg interaction gap
WITH fan_gaps AS (
    SELECT interact_fan_pivot, 
           AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time_mark - prev_time)) / 86400.0) AS avg_gap_days
    FROM (
        SELECT interact_fan_pivot, time_mark,
               LAG(time_mark) OVER (PARTITION BY interact_fan_pivot ORDER BY time_mark) AS prev_time
        FROM interactions
    ) sub
    WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot
),
at_risk_fans AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.user_registry, f.nick_label
    FROM retentionandinfluence r
    JOIN engagement e ON r.retain_engage_pivot = e.engage_reg
    JOIN membershipandspending ms ON e.engage_member_pivot = ms.member_reg
    JOIN fans f ON ms.member_fan_pivot = f.user_registry
    WHERE r.churn_flag = 'High' OR e.eng_rate < 0.4
)
SELECT arf.nick_label, ROUND(CAST(fg.avg_gap_days AS numeric), 2) AS avg_interaction_gap
FROM at_risk_fans arf
JOIN fan_gaps fg ON arf.user_registry = fg.interact_fan_pivot
GROUP BY arf.user_registry, arf.nick_label, fg.avg_gap_days
